author: SKIZZOO
name: JuiceVault
description: Continuously plays audio from JuiceVault's Music archive in a Discord voice channel and loops the archive.
install_msg: Install FFmpeg on the machine running Red. Then use [p]jv start while you are in the target voice channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only the configured guild voice channel ID and enabled state. It does not store personal user data.
